cases.title_zh: ACA 支持《Doctors Not AI Act》：保險 AI 不得取代臨床判斷
cases.title_en: ACA backs Doctors Not AI Act to curb AI-driven insurance coverage denials
cases.summary_zh: 美國諮商學會（ACA）宣布與另外 44 個心理健康與醫療組織共同支持兩黨法案《Doctors Not AI Act》（H.R. 10210）。該法案針對保險公司以 AI、演算法自動審查理賠、決定醫療必要性的做法設下防線：凡需臨床判斷的拒保決定，必須由具適當專長的持牌醫療人員做出，且須提高透明度並考量個人情況。
cases.summary_en: On 2 Oct 2026 the American Counseling Association joined 44 other mental-health and medical organizations backing the bipartisan Doctors Not AI Act (H.R. 10210): insurers could not use AI alone to deny coverage, medical-necessity denials would need a licensed professional with appropriate expertise, with more transparency and individual circumstances considered.

cases.title_zh: EMDR 與部分工作治療複雜性創傷（免費直播）
cases.title_en: EMDR & Parts Work for Treating Complex Trauma (Free Live Event)
cases.summary_zh: Psychotherapy Networker 舉辦的免費直播課程，於 2026-10-22 美東時間上午 10:30 至下午 6:00 線上舉行。課程聚焦以 EMDR 結合部分工作（parts work）與身體取向技巧，協助臨床工作者降低個案防衛、促進創傷處理。原價 $249.99，現免費參加，需線上報名。
cases.summary_en: Free live online event from Psychotherapy Networker on 22 Oct 2026 (10:30am–6:00pm EDT) on combining EMDR, parts work and body-oriented techniques for complex trauma; listed at $0 instead of $249.99.

cases.title_zh: 自閉症學生為何在校較不快樂？英國 8,348 名青少年資料：學業自信與霸凌是關鍵
cases.title_en: Autistic pupils' happiness at school
cases.summary_zh: National Elf Service 評介一項英國全國代表性樣本研究（8,348 名青少年，其中 271 名自閉症）：自閉症學生約 27% 表示大多或全部時間在校不快樂，非自閉症學生約 14%。但在納入學業自我概念、霸凌、同儕關係、家庭親密度與社經地位後，差距消失；在自閉症學生中，學業自信是在校快樂感最強的預測因子。
cases.summary_en: A Mental Elf blog reviews a UK nationally representative study (8,348 adolescents, 271 autistic): about 27% of autistic pupils felt unhappy at school most or all of the time versus 14% of peers, but the gap disappeared after accounting for academic self-concept, bullying, peer relationships, family closeness and SES. Academic confidence was the strongest predictor of school happiness among autistic pupils.

cases.title_zh: 短程 EMDR 用於人格障礙：荷蘭 RCT 顯示五週十次後症狀與診斷狀態改善
cases.title_en: Brief EMDR for personality disorders RCT
cases.summary_zh: Mental Elf 評介一項荷蘭兩所門診的隨機對照試驗（JAMA Network Open, 2025）：159 名人格障礙成人隨機分到 EMDR（每週兩次、共十次 90 分鐘）或候補名單。三個月追蹤時，以 ADP-IV 衡量 EMDR 組 44.1% 不再符合人格障礙標準，控制組 15.8%；人格障礙症狀、人格功能與情緒調節亦改善，中止率僅 5.1%、未報告不良事件。評論者提醒對照組是候補名單、追蹤期短。
cases.summary_en: A Mental Elf blog reviews a Dutch RCT (JAMA Network Open, 2025) in which 159 adults with personality disorders received ten 90-minute EMDR sessions over five weeks or waiting list. At three-month follow-up, 44.1% of the EMDR group no longer met PD criteria on the ADP-IV versus 15.8% of controls, with gains in PD symptoms, personality functioning and emotion regulation, 5.1% dropout and no reported adverse events. The reviewer notes the waiting-list comparator and short follow-up.

cases.title_zh: 憂鬱高風險兒童會「卡」在悲傷臉孔：眼動追蹤研究顯示兩種注意力路徑
cases.title_en: Attention bias to sad faces in at-risk children
cases.summary_zh: Binghamton 大學的縱貫研究（Journal of Psychopathology and Clinical Science, 2026）以眼動追蹤，每六個月評估一次、追蹤 242 名兒童兩年。母親有重鬱症史的兒童，在自身憂鬱症狀上升時對悲傷臉孔的注意增加；母親無憂鬱史的兒童則是症狀上升時對快樂臉孔的注意減少，顯示憂鬱可能依家族風險經由不同的注意力路徑發展。
cases.summary_en: A Binghamton University longitudinal study (Journal of Psychopathology and Clinical Science, 2026) used eye tracking every six months over two years in 242 children. Children of mothers with a history of major depression attended more to sad faces as their depressive symptoms rose, whereas children without maternal depression showed reduced attention to happy faces, suggesting distinct attentional pathways by familial risk.

cases.title_zh: 12 歲孤單、18 歲孤立：2,232 名雙胞胎追蹤顯示兒童期孤單與孤立的長期代價
cases.title_en: Childhood loneliness and isolation into adulthood
cases.summary_zh: PsyPost 報導一項刊於 Development and Psychopathology 的縱貫研究，追蹤 2,232 名英格蘭與威爾斯雙胞胎從 12 歲到 18 歲。12 歲感到孤單的兒童，到 18 歲成為社交孤立者的機率約為兩倍；兒童期社交孤立與 18 歲時未就學未就業（NEET）勝算 2.4 倍相關。孤單與孤立各自獨立預測較差的心理健康、幸福感與社經結果。
cases.summary_en: PsyPost reports a Development and Psychopathology study following 2,232 twins in England and Wales from age 12 to 18. Children who felt lonely at 12 were about twice as likely to be socially isolated at 18, and childhood isolation was linked to 2.4 times higher odds of being NEET. Loneliness and isolation independently predicted poorer mental health, wellbeing and socioeconomic outcomes.

cases.title_zh: 焦慮家長的自助線上課程能預防孩子焦慮嗎？1,811 人 RCT 的小效果與低完成率
cases.title_en: Online program for anxious parents prevents child anxiety
cases.summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格評介一項平行組隨機對照試驗（Dunn 等，2024）：1,811 名高焦慮家長（子女 2–11 歲）分為無人引導的線上模組組或控制組，模組每單元約 20 分鐘，涵蓋減少迴避、情緒教練、減少過度保護等。六個月時介入組子女的家長評焦慮顯著較低（d = −0.16），家長焦慮也下降；但約 32% 完成兩個以上模組、約 19% 全部完成。
cases.summary_en: An ACAMH blog reviews a parallel-group RCT (Dunn et al., 2024) in which 1,811 highly anxious parents of children aged 2–11 were randomised to unguided online modules (about 20 minutes each, covering avoidance, emotion coaching, overprotection) or control. At six months, parent-reported child anxiety was significantly lower (d = −0.16) and parental anxiety also fell, but only about 32% completed two or more modules and about 19% completed all.

cases.title_zh: 青少年「失眠」可能是晝夜節律延遲：挪威研究近九成有相位後移指標
cases.title_en: Adolescent insomnia vs circadian delay
cases.summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格整理挪威 3,867 名高中生的研究（Arnesen 等，2025）：34.5% 符合失眠標準，但其中 88.4% 呈現晝夜節律延遲的指標。作者建議評估上學日與假日的睡眠時間差、延後就寢是否改善入睡、週末補眠等；失眠以 CBT-I 處理，節律延遲則考慮光照、褪黑激素時機與逐步提前起床時間，而非只叫孩子早點上床。
cases.summary_en: An ACAMH blog summarises a study of 3,867 Norwegian high-school students (Arnesen et al., 2025): 34.5% met insomnia criteria, yet 88.4% of these showed indicators of circadian delay. The author recommends assessing school-day vs free-day sleep timing, response to later bedtimes and weekend catch-up sleep; CBT-I for insomnia, and light, melatonin timing and gradual wake-time advances for circadian delay rather than simply earlier bedtimes.

cases.title_zh: 青少年自傷：把每次接觸服務變成照護機會——英國 544 名自殺身亡青少年資料
cases.title_en: Youth self-harm and service contact before suicide
cases.summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格評介英國全國連續案例系列研究（Aggarwal 等，British Journal of Psychiatry, 2025）：544 名 10–19 歲自殺身亡者中 49% 有自傷紀錄、26% 有近期自傷；近期自傷者中 60% 在死亡前三個月內曾接觸心理健康服務，95% 經歷近期逆境。另有 51% 沒有自傷紀錄。作者建議評估不只看自傷行為，也要看關係、安全與環境壓力，並提供協調的個別化照護與 48 小時內的後續追蹤。
cases.summary_en: An ACAMH blog reviews a UK consecutive case series (Aggarwal et al., British Journal of Psychiatry, 2025) of 544 young people aged 10–19 who died by suicide: 49% had a self-harm history and 26% recent self-harm; among those with recent self-harm, 60% had contact with mental health services in the prior three months and 95% had recent adversity, while 51% had no recorded self-harm. The author urges broader assessment of relationships, safety and stressors, coordinated care and 48-hour follow-up.

cases.title_zh: 加州州長否決 SB 903：AI 心理治療限制法案未能成法
cases.title_en: Newsom vetoes California SB 903 on AI in therapy
cases.summary_zh: 加州州長 Newsom 否決了 SB 903。該法案原本要禁止 AI 演算法提供或宣傳心理治療服務，持照專業人員只能把 AI 用於行政或輔助支援，用 AI 錄製治療會談前須清楚揭露並取得同意，也不准 AI 獨立與個案互動或作治療決定。法案在參議院全票通過、眾議院以 71 比 4 通過；州長的否決理由認為對病人與臨床人員的保護「過了頭」，提案人 Padilla 則強烈批評。
cases.summary_en: California Governor Gavin Newsom vetoed SB 903, which would have barred AI from providing or advertising therapy, limited licensed clinicians to administrative or supplementary AI use, required disclosure and consent before AI recording of sessions, and banned AI from independently interacting with clients or making therapeutic decisions. The bill had passed the Senate unanimously and the Assembly 71-4; the veto message said its protections went too far, drawing sharp criticism from author Sen. Steve Padilla.

cases.title_zh: 加州簽署三項醫療 AI 法案：AI 只能當顧問、須處理演算法偏誤
cases.title_en: California signs three healthcare AI bills
cases.summary_zh: 加州州長簽署三項醫療 AI 法案：AB 1979 把 AI 在臨床照護中限於諮詢角色、不得執行需執照的臨床功能，並保護經由聊天機器人取得的病人健康資訊；SB 503 要求醫療 AI 開發者與使用者辨識、減輕並持續監測臨床決策支援系統的偏誤風險；AB 1609 禁止大型企業把客服聊天機器人包裝成真人。同時被否決的有 AB 2575 和處理 AI 心理治療的 SB 903。
cases.summary_en: California's governor signed three healthcare AI bills: AB 1979 restricts AI to an advisory role in clinical care, bars it from performing licensed clinical functions and protects health information accessed through chatbots; SB 503 requires developers and deployers to identify, mitigate and monitor bias risks in clinical decision support; AB 1609 bars large enterprises from presenting customer-service chatbots as human. AB 2575 and the AI-in-psychotherapy bill SB 903 were vetoed.

cases.title_zh: 康乃狄克州 AI 陪伴法 10 月 1 日生效：須有自殺自傷應對流程
cases.title_en: Connecticut AI companion rules take effect October 1
cases.summary_zh: 康乃狄克州 Public Act 26-15 自 2026 年 10 月 1 日起生效，規範能在多次互動中維持關係、具擬人回應的 AI 陪伴服務。業者須定期提醒用戶正在與 AI 互動、建立偵測並回應自殺或自傷跡象的流程、禁止操縱性或有害互動；若知道或合理相信用戶是未成年人，還須取得家長同意才能提供演算法推送，禁止誘導消費或延長使用、禁止浪漫或性露骨互動，並限制通知頻率。
cases.summary_en: Connecticut Public Act 26-15, effective October 1, 2026, regulates AI companions that sustain human-like relationships across interactions. Operators must periodically disclose that users are talking to AI, maintain protocols to detect and respond to suicide or self-harm indicators, and avoid manipulative or harmful interactions. For known or likely minors, they need parental consent for algorithmic feeds, may not manipulate them into purchases or longer engagement, must block romantic or sexually explicit interactions and limit notifications.

cases.title_zh: 佛州檢察總長聲請禁制令：要求禁止未成年人使用 ChatGPT、移除擬人特徵
cases.title_en: Florida seeks injunction against OpenAI over ChatGPT
cases.summary_zh: 佛羅里達州檢察總長 James Uthmeier 在 2026 年 6 月對 OpenAI 與 Sam Altman 提告，案件一度被移往聯邦法院，本月發回 Highlands County 州法院；州政府現聲請臨時禁制令。請求包括禁止佛州未成年人使用 ChatGPT、未經家長同意不得收集 13 歲以下兒童資料、不得誇大安全性、移除第一人稱等擬人化對話特徵、停止刻意延長使用的設計，以及新模型須有獨立安全保障才能開發。OpenAI 發言人回應應由業界與各州共同制定規則。
cases.summary_en: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier, who sued OpenAI and Sam Altman in June 2026, has moved for a temporary injunction in Highlands County circuit court. The state asks the court to bar Florida minors from ChatGPT, stop data collection from under-13s without parental consent, prohibit safety misrepresentations, remove human-like conversational features including first-person language, end engagement-prolonging practices and require independent safeguards before new model development. OpenAI said it favors industry-wide rules developed with states.

cases.title_zh: 歐盟 KIDS Act 官方問答：AI 陪伴不得對兒少製造情感依賴
cases.title_en: EU KIDS Act FAQ on AI companions for minors
cases.summary_zh: 歐盟執委會發布 KIDS Act 問答說明。草案規定 AI 陪伴與聊天機器人面對未成年人時，不得以製造情感依賴的方式模擬人際關係、不得自動延續孩子先前的對話、不得自動啟動或強推給兒童或難以關閉；13 歲以下只能透過家長控制工具使用，並須在上線前做風險測試、持續監測傷害。公眾可在 2026 年 11 月 26 日前提交意見，違規最高罰全球年營業額 6%。
cases.summary_en: The European Commission published an FAQ on the proposed KIDS Act. For minors, AI companions and chatbots may not simulate human relationships in ways that create emotional dependency, automatically carry forward a child's previous conversations, or auto-launch, be pushed at children or be hard to disable; under-13s may use them only via parental controls, with pre-launch risk testing and ongoing harm monitoring. Public feedback is open until 26 November 2026, and fines can reach 6% of worldwide turnover.

cases.title_zh: 免費督導 CE 直播：督導中的困難處理，從擔憂到補救（11/13）
cases.title_en: Free clinical supervision forum: from concern to remediation
cases.summary_zh: Telehealth Certification Institute 的「臨床督導論壇」是免費的線上直播系列，每場 1.5 小時 CE，APA、NBCC、ASWB ACE、NAADAC 等均有認可。2026 年 11 月 13 日（美東 13:00–14:30）由 Amie Bryant, LCSW, CAS, ACS 主講「Managing Difficulties in Clinical Supervision: From Concern to Remediation」，討論研究所訓練留下的落差，以及如何在不同能力階段支持受督者成長。
cases.summary_en: Telehealth Certification Institute runs a free live Clinical Supervision Forum webinar series worth 1.5 CE per session (APA, NBCC, ASWB ACE, NAADAC and NY State approvals). The Nov 13, 2026 session (1:00–2:30 pm ET), presented by Amie Bryant, LCSW, CAS, ACS, covers managing difficulties in supervision from concern to remediation and supporting supervisees across competency stages.

training.ce_credits: 1.5 小時 CE（APA、NBCC、ASWB ACE、NAADAC、紐約州相關委員會認可）

cases.title_zh: Sue Johnson 親授伴侶 EFT 錄影課，每集 40 美元含 CE
cases.title_en: Sue Johnson EFT webinar series on demand with CE
cases.summary_zh: 美國 National Register of Health Service Psychologists 提供四集由 Sue Johnson 主講的情緒取向治療（Emotionally Focused Therapy，Sue Johnson 系，非 Greenberg 的 Emotion-Focused Therapy）錄影課，主題包括以依附為本的伴侶介入、EFT Tango 與微介入、Hold Me Tight 對話與依附創傷修復，以及創傷伴侶。每集 40 美元，含 1–1.5 小時 CE，課程等級標示為進階。
cases.summary_en: The National Register of Health Service Psychologists offers four recorded webinars by Dr. Sue Johnson on Emotionally Focused Therapy (the Johnson model, not Greenberg's Emotion-Focused Therapy), covering attachment-based couple intervention, the EFT Tango, Hold Me Tight conversations and attachment injuries, and trauma couples. Each costs US$40 including 1–1.5 CE credits; instructional level is advanced.

training.provider: National Register of Health Service Psychologists
training.ce_credits: 第一集 1.5 小時、第二至四集各 1 小時（APA 認可主辦單位）

cases.title_zh: 多迷走神經研究所 10–11 月免費線上活動：Deb Dana 問答、Porges 談言語發展
cases.title_en: Polyvagal Institute free online community events Oct–Nov 2026
cases.summary_zh: 註冊為 501(c)(3) 非營利組織的 Polyvagal Institute 在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月有五場免費 Zoom 活動，包括 11/6 共同創辦人 Deb Dana 的問答，以及 11/14 Stephen Porges 與國際講者討論言語、語言發展與自律神經系統的 90 分鐘座談。報名即可在活動後收到錄影（Deb Dana 場錄影只開放兩週）。
cases.summary_en: The Polyvagal Institute, a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, hosts five free Zoom community events in Oct–Nov 2026, including a Q&A with co-founder Deb Dana (Nov 6) and a 90-minute conversation with Stephen Porges and international panelists on speech, language development and the autonomic nervous system (Nov 14). Registrants receive recordings afterwards.

cases.title_zh: 情緒取向家庭治療（EFFT）低價短課：治療性道歉、無望感回應，10–35 美元
cases.title_en: Low-cost on-demand EFFT short courses by Adèle Lafrance
cases.summary_zh: 情緒取向家庭治療（Emotion-Focused Family Therapy, EFFT）創始人 Adèle Lafrance 的網站有多門隨選短課，其中低於 50 美元的包括「Responding to Hopelessness」（10 美元、20 分鐘）、「Universal Apology in Clinical Practice」（25 美元、45 分鐘）、「Emotion-Focused Homework Ideas」（25 美元、55 分鐘）、「Transforming Childhood Pain」與「Process of Emotional Self-Exploration」（各 35 美元）。EFFT 屬 Greenberg 系的情緒焦點取向（網站引用 Lafrance Robinson、Dolhanty 與 Greenberg 2015 年論文），不是 Sue Johnson 系。
cases.summary_en: Adèle Lafrance, creator of Emotion-Focused Family Therapy (EFFT), offers on-demand short courses, several under US$50: Responding to Hopelessness ($10, 20 min), Universal Apology in Clinical Practice ($25, 45 min), Emotion-Focused Homework Ideas ($25, 55 min), and Transforming Childhood Pain and Process of Emotional Self-Exploration ($35 each). EFFT belongs to the Greenberg emotion-focused lineage (the site cites Lafrance Robinson, Dolhanty & Greenberg, 2015), not Sue Johnson's model.

training.ce_credits: 低價短課頁面未列 CE

cases.title_zh: Classroom WISE：免費自學的學校心理健康素養課程
cases.title_en: Classroom WISE free school mental health literacy course
cases.summary_zh: Classroom WISE 由美國 MHTTC 網絡與馬里蘭大學醫學院 National Center for School Mental Health 合作開發，是免費的三部分訓練包，包括自學線上課程、影片庫與資源集。內容涵蓋心理健康素養、辨識學生困擾、降溫技巧、創傷知情與包容的課室環境，對象是 K-12 教師、學校人員與學校心理健康專業人員。
cases.summary_en: Classroom WISE, developed by the MHTTC Network with the National Center for School Mental Health at the University of Maryland School of Medicine, is a free three-part package with a self-paced online course, video library and resource collection. It covers mental health literacy, recognizing student distress, de-escalation, trauma-informed and inclusive classrooms for K-12 educators and school staff.

training.provider: MHTTC Network、National Center for School Mental Health（University of Maryland School of Medicine）
training.format: 自學線上課程（含影片庫與資源集）

cases.title_zh: Pat Ogden 免費錄影講座：感覺動作心理治療談創傷下的復原力
cases.title_en: Free Pat Ogden webinar on resilience amid trauma
cases.summary_zh: Leading Edge Seminars 與 Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Institute（SPI）、SensorimotorItalia.it 合作，免費公開 Pat Ogden 與 Rebeca Farca 的錄影講座「Building Resilience in Times of War, Violence & Other Traumatic Events」。內容介紹如何協助長期處於壓力與威脅下的案主，並附講義、給案主用的 PEACE protocol 與給臨床人員的 SPI protocol 可下載。
cases.summary_en: Leading Edge Seminars, with the Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Institute and SensorimotorItalia.it, offers a free recorded webinar by Pat Ogden and Rebeca Farca, 'Building Resilience in Times of War, Violence & Other Traumatic Events'. It shows how to help clients living with long-term stress and threat, with a downloadable handout, a PEACE protocol for clients and an SPI protocol for clinicians.

training.provider: Leading Edge Seminars（與 Sensorimotor Psychotherapy Institute 合作）

cases.title_zh: 港大防自殺中心：學童自殺不能只歸咎「適應期」，前線守門員要補位
cases.title_en: HKU CSRP: student suicides not explained by adjustment period
cases.summary_zh: 港大香港賽馬會防止自殺研究中心高級培訓顧問張鳳儀接受東網訪問時指出，開學「適應期」可能帶來壓力，但不能充分解釋學童自殺；自殺通常由多重因素造成，約三成自殺離世學生生前曾被診斷有精神健康問題或有相關醫療服務紀錄。她建議加強前線教師的精神健康及防止自殺培訓、重視教師身心健康、建立人人都是「守門員」的文化，並加強家校合作。
cases.summary_en: A senior training consultant at HKU's Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention told on.cc that the school 'adjustment period' cannot fully explain student suicides; about 30% of students who died by suicide had prior mental health diagnoses or service records. She urged gatekeeper training for teachers, attention to teacher wellbeing, and stronger home–school partnership.

cases.title_zh: 港大賽馬會 ADHD 支援計劃：全校三層模式，已培訓逾 6,000 名學生
cases.title_en: HKU JCKAK whole-school 3-tier ADHD support framework
cases.summary_zh: 香港大學心理學系介紹「Jockey Club Keen and Active Kids Project（JCKAK）」：由 Kathy Shum 教授團隊主導、香港賽馬會慈善信託基金資助，自 2019 年起與教育局及五間非政府機構合作，在主流中小學以全校三層介入模式支援 ADHD 學生。計劃已為逾 6,000 名學生提供實證為本訓練、裝備逾 4,000 名教育工作者，並以工作坊支援 1,500 名家長，另有數碼工具與手冊。
cases.summary_en: HKU Psychology describes JCKAK, a Jockey Club–funded ADHD support project led by Prof. Kathy Shum's team since 2019 with the Education Bureau and five NGOs. Using a whole-school 3-tier model, it has trained over 6,000 students and 4,000 educators and supported 1,500 parents.

cases.title_zh: 香港精神科醫學院免費講座：反歧視、破謬誤，談思覺失調
cases.title_en: HKCPsych free public lecture on psychosis stigma
cases.summary_zh: 香港精神科醫學院「正視精神」公眾講座系列，於 2026 年 10 月 31 日（六）晚上 7 時至 9 時在香港中央圖書館地下演講廳舉行，由精神科專科醫生劉育成主講，內容包括破解對思覺失調的誤解、個案分享及互動問答。講座免費，名額有限，先到先得。
cases.summary_en: A free public lecture by the Hong Kong College of Psychiatrists on 31 Oct 2026 (7–9 pm, Hong Kong Central Library) on debunking myths and stigma about psychosis, with case sharing and Q&A. First come, first served.

training.format: 實體講座（香港中央圖書館地下演講廳）

cases.title_zh: 兒福聯盟調查：三成五國高中生有容貌焦慮，口罩成「第二張臉」
cases.title_en: Taiwan survey: 35% of teens report appearance anxiety
cases.summary_zh: 兒福聯盟問卷調查全臺一萬多名國高中生，35.4% 自陳有容貌焦慮，少女 48.7%、少男 20.6%；23.5% 每天超過一半時間戴口罩，37.2% 看到他人網路照片後曾覺得自己很醜，47.8% 曾被平台主動推播相關內容。高容貌焦慮組有 25.1% 嚴重情緒困擾、29.6% 有自殺意念；兒盟建議理解口罩背後的心理防衛、避免強摘口罩或批評外貌，並以「鏡子練習」建立自我接納。
cases.summary_en: A Children's Welfare League survey of over 10,000 Taiwanese secondary students found 35.4% report appearance anxiety (girls 48.7%, boys 20.6%). Among high-anxiety students, 29.6% reported suicidal ideation; 47.8% said platforms pushed appearance-related content to them.

cases.title_zh: 台灣兒少心智病房延宕，年底先開北中部 21 床
cases.title_en: Taiwan youth psychiatric crisis wards to open 21 beds
cases.summary_zh: 聯合報報導，衛福部規劃的兒少心智專責病房原訂 2025 年底在台大醫院、台中榮總完成建置，但因空間改建、消防安全及硬體設備問題延宕，目前仍未有病床啟用。心理健康司司長陳柏熹表示，預計今年底先啟用北部、中部共 21 床，南部其餘 9 床仍在採購；病房以 18 歲以下、家庭學校與一般門診已難處理的急迫危機個案為主要收治對象。
cases.summary_en: Taiwan's planned child and adolescent psychiatric crisis wards were delayed by renovation, fire-safety and equipment problems. The Department of Mental Health says 21 beds in the north and centre should open by end-2026, with 9 southern beds still in procurement.

cases.title_zh: 世界心理健康日前夕，台灣心理健康聯盟提「不平等」三層解方
cases.title_en: Taiwan Mental Health Alliance's three-level fix for inequality
cases.summary_zh: 公視報導，台灣心理健康聯盟在 10/10 世界心理健康日前夕，提出解決心理健康不平等的三層解方：上游從經濟安全、平等包容消除歧視與汙名，中游以系統與政策提供可近資源，下游讓個人有穩定身心健康與歸屬感。國衛院副院長陳為堅提醒，不處理上游風險因子，只靠末端用藥會持續產生問題；衛福部心理健康司司長陳柏熹表示，將規劃把癌友納入免費心理諮詢補助，近期上路。
cases.summary_en: Ahead of World Mental Health Day, the Taiwan Mental Health Alliance proposed upstream (economic security, anti-stigma), midstream (accessible services and policy) and downstream (individual wellbeing and belonging) solutions to mental health inequality. The Ministry said cancer patients will soon be included in its free counselling subsidy.

cases.title_zh: 澳門仁伯爵醫院 10/14 精神科衛教講座：口服藥副作用與處理
cases.title_en: Macao CSJ Hospital talk on psychiatric medication side effects
cases.summary_zh: 澳門衛生局公布仁伯爵綜合醫院 10 月份專科衛教講座，其中精神科講座「認識精神科口服藥常見的副作用及處理」於 10 月 14 日下午 2 時 30 分至 3 時 30 分，在門診大樓地下層精神科候診區舉行，由專科護士或資深護士主講，毋須預約。對心理治療師而言，可作為轉介或陪同服藥個案與家屬了解藥物副作用的社區資源。
cases.summary_en: Macao's Health Bureau lists a free, walk-in talk at Conde S. Januário Hospital on 14 Oct 2026 (2:30–3:30 pm, psychiatry waiting area) on common side effects of oral psychiatric medication and how to manage them, given by specialist or senior nurses.

cases.title_zh: 識別青少年及年輕成人精神病早期徵兆
cases.title_en: Identifying Early Signs of Psychosis in Adolescents and Young Adults
cases.summary_zh: 史丹佛醫學院精神科的免費線上 CME（約 2 小時，2.00 AMA PRA Category 1 學分，2027-01-07 到期）：以敘事與案例示範，訓練臨床工作者識別青少年及年輕成人精神病早期徵兆、運用高產出篩查問句，並學習如何與年輕人及其家庭談論精神病。適合家醫、兒科、精神科、護理及學校社工。
cases.summary_en: Stanford's free on-demand CME (2 hrs, 2.00 AMA PRA Category 1 credits, expires 2027-01-07) trains clinicians to recognize early signs of psychosis in adolescents and young adults, use high-yield screening questions, and talk with young people and families about psychosis, using narrative storytelling and case scenarios.

cases.summary_en: A 7-week self-paced course from the University of Queensland covering causes of psychological disorders, effective therapies, and management of common issues like anxiety, depression and schizophrenia.

cases.summary_en: A 6-week Curtin University edX course (German-Australian collaboration) on recognising and responding to mental health challenges and suicide risk in young adults, aimed at parents, teachers and health professionals as gatekeepers.
